Title: Gym Access Requests
Intro: Review permission for Trainers to offer Programs at GymFlow venues.
Filter hint: Filters match exact Trainer or Gym IDs. Name search is not available.
Approve copy: Authorize this Trainer to offer eligible Programs at this Gym. Current Trainer and Gym eligibility will be checked when you confirm.
Reject copy: Rejection is final for this request. The Trainer can submit a new request later. Explain your decision below.
Revoke copy: New Gym-linked Program use and new bookings will no longer be authorized. Existing Programs and Reservations are preserved.
Decision note: Review the Trainer, Gym and request before making a decision. Approval grants GymFlow venue permission.
Terminal note: This record is closed. The Trainer must submit a new request for another review.
Reason error: Enter a reason containing 1–1000 characters after trimming.
Reason hint: This reason is visible to the Trainer.
Access denied: An active administrator account is required.
Load error: Gym access could not be loaded. Try again.
Not found: This gym access request is unavailable.
Reconciled: The persisted decision has been loaded. No additional decision was sent.
Conflict: This request changed or is no longer eligible for that decision. Review the latest state before another action.
Eligibility: Approval requires an active Trainer account. Review the latest Trainer and Gym state before continuing.
Uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. Your reason is kept. Reload the latest state before retrying; the decision will not be sent automatically.
Mutation error: The decision could not be confirmed. Your reason is kept. Reload the latest state before continuing.
Sync error: The decision was saved, but the latest state could not be loaded. Reload before another action.
